messages.content: Do you ever just say something to be funny, even if it's a little mean?
Occasionally, yeah - if it's playful and the other person can clearly take it. I read the room first though, I'm not trying to actually hurt anyone.
good, i was worried you were secretly savage
Only situationally savage. Mostly I'm just honest, which people sometimes mistake for savage.
